candidates.explanation: After the forgot-password hash is verified, resetPassword only sets the new password and calls usersService.update. It never revokes the user's existing sessions. Sessions on other devices stay valid, so their refresh tokens still pass the session lookup in AuthService.refreshToken and the phone can keep renewing its login. The password-change path in AuthService.update (around line 469) does call sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude, but the reset flow has no equivalent call.

fix.description: In resetPassword, after the user is updated with the new password, call `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`. This revokes every session, because a reset has no current session to exclude.
